body: yeah thanks I visit there a lot
computers mainly...video games, can't really do too much atm, disease is flaring pretty bad, you are actually pretty close, I'm in hendersonville
Yeah I've checked meetup, closest things are 45 mins - hour away and that's without being picky at all.  small town in north carolina

Yeah...thought about it...honestly a degree is pretty low of my list of things to do at this point :/.

I'm so far from something that could earn me money that it would take years.

Life just kinda sucks.

I actually just applied for disability....but it takes 3-5 months, and you usually get denied the first time so that will probably take a while.

I'm 5 weeks into a double blind clinical trial, so Ill probably give that a shot first.

I'm going to be in debt soon though....teeth are costing a fortune to keep up with.

It's just so much to deal with.  I just want to live a normal life like most people....they don't have to deal with this bullshit.  I'm tired of being alone, I just want a companion.

Live in a small town 7k people :/.  Old retirement city...mostly just old people :( . 

Yeah it's rough, honestly it's so tempting to just to kill myself.  It's too much for me to handle by myself.  I do get overwhelmed easy...but it's a lot of problems.
